trello.name: Finalize venue contract with AV recording requirements
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Deadline: End of next week. Actions: Get the convention center contract through legal review and secure signature. Ensure the contract explicitly confirms that the AV package includes recording capabilities in all three rooms (main hall plus two breakout rooms) to prevent issues from last year. Confirm the total cost is within the $18,000 budget for the venue space.

trello.name: Lock speaker lineup and secure keynote abstract
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Deadline: Two weeks from now for lineup; this week for abstract. Actions: Send final follow-ups to the two 'maybe' speakers with a decision deadline of this Friday. If either declines, fill the slot from the backup list of five names. Lock the full speaker lineup (9 speakers total) to allow for agenda printing. Chase Dr. Osei to obtain the keynote abstract immediately for use on the website and printed program.

trello.name: Draft three-wave email marketing campaign
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Deadline: Drafts completed this month. Actions: Draft three email waves: 1) Agenda announcement (to be sent the day the agenda goes live), 2) Early-bird deadline reminder (two weeks before price change), and 3) Final-week push. Coordinate with Bo to ensure speaker pages are live before sending the first wave.

trello.name: Update website with speaker bios and headshots
trello.desc: Owner: Diego (receiving from Bo). Timing: Same day the lineup is locked. Actions: Once Bo locks the speaker lineup, he must immediately hand off speaker bios and headshots to Diego. Diego must update the landing page with these details before the first email wave is sent.

trello.name: Approve swag design proofs and place order
trello.desc: Owner: Camille (approval), Diego (ordering). Deadline: Camille to approve today; Diego to order this week. Actions: Camille to review and approve the swag design proofs in the shared drive today. Upon approval, Diego must place the order for 800 shirts, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers (approx. $9,200) immediately to account for the six-week lead time.
